Contributors: Días Portaly, Josef; San Martín Suárez, José de; Solano y Bote, José, marqués del Socorro, 1726-1806

Depths shown by soundings. Shows coasts of southern United States, eastern Mexico, eastern Central America, northern South America, and West Indies. Includes tables of "Nombres de los cayos del canal viejo" and "Nombres de los cayos del nte. de la Havana." Scale ca. 1:3,250,000.
